name: Kapow
description: Kapow — a tablet-first browser comic book editor.

RAILS_MASTER_KEY.description: Decrypts config/credentials.yml.enc — required for Rails to boot in production.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: IAM access key for the S3 bucket used to store uploaded photos (Active Storage). See config/storage.yml.

AWS_REGION.description: AWS region the S3 bucket lives in.

AWS_BUCKET.description: Name of the (already-created) S3 bucket used to store uploaded photos.
